channel.title: New Zealand Gazette (synthetic fixture)
channel.description: Invented notices for testing the Delta Rule.

item.title: Water Services Charges Amendment Order 2026 commences 1 November 2026
item.description: The Water Services Charges Amendment Order 2026 comes into force on 1 November 2026. It raises the fixed daily charge for metered residential connections in the Auckland region from 65 cents to 78 cents per day. Existing connections are not required to take any action.

item.title: Notice of appointment of a liquidator - Example Holdings Limited
item.description: Notice is given that a liquidator was appointed to Example Holdings Limited on 18 September 2026. Creditors are required to submit claims by 30 October 2026.

item.title: Proposed amendment to the Example Fisheries Notice 2019 - submissions invited
item.description: The Ministry proposes amending the Example Fisheries Notice 2019. No decision has been made. Submissions on the proposal may be made in writing.

item.title: Road user charges rates increase confirmed for 1 October 2026
item.description: Road user charges rates increase from 1 October 2026 for all diesel vehicles under 3.5 tonnes. The rate rises from $76 to $82 per 1000 kilometres.

item.title: Example Regional Council land drainage rate - consultation closes 12 October 2026
item.description: Example Regional Council gives notice that submissions on the proposed land drainage targeted rate close at 5pm on 12 October 2026. The rate would apply to rating units in the Auckland region within the scheme boundary. Submissions received after that time cannot be considered.

item.title: Appointment of members to the Example Advisory Committee
item.description: The Minister has appointed three members to the Example Advisory Committee for a term of three years commencing 1 October 2026.
